`PHOTOS.DBF`, from the `ha1tch/VPFX-Samples` mirror,
`Solution/Europa/photos.dbf`. Three records, VFP `0x32`.

The `CREATED` field (DateTime) is the specimen that settled the
DateTime epoch question open since v0.8.6: decoding it under
dBASE 7's documented Julian-day formula gives 2004-10-12,
14:03/14:20/14:22 — three photos taken minutes apart, matching
VFP 9's 2004 release year. See docs/RESEARCH_NOTES.md.
